archive_behind_reason: by design: Minima writes a block to its archive only when the chain tree cuts it into the cascade, 100 blocks at a time, so the archive stays about a day behind the tip. The figures on this page do not wait for it.

scope.note: USDw, coverage and leverage are not part of this test (Council decision TV81-D23). Winiwa and xWiniwa are valueless test tokens.

sources.archive: minima_archive.coins, canonical row per coin (max mmrentrynumber); archive lags the tip by the cascade window
sources.node: txpow block:N and coins address: on the Council node, scanned forward and kept on disk
sources.holders: archive position at its head, carried to the tip by the node's coin ledger (every Winiwa and xWiniwa coin created or spent in the scanned window)
